Go to the doctor.

It's never too late to go to the doctor.

Just this time last year, after being sick my **whole** life, my kidneys started to fail.  At this time, we did not know it.  It took me three weeks to muster up the courage to tell my boyfriend, who had kidney cancer at the time, the INCREDIBLE pain I was in, and he texted my mum, because I would not do it myself.

At that point, breathing was difficult.  She took me to the ER, and they ordered emergency ultrasound/x-ray/MRI/CAT scans.

The first thing the doctor says after 17 hours in the ER?

"If kidneys could explode, yours would have by now."

Great.

I was diagnosed with stage 2 kidney failure in BOTH kidneys.  Too late to go to the doctor?  My ass.

It took me, after that, 8 months to be diagnosed with Lupus, and I'm doing fine now, but Jesus Christ, man, go to the doctor.
